name: build_fire_map_link
title: Build a FIRMS Fire Map link
description:
Build a link that opens the NASA FIRMS Fire Map (https://firms.modaps.eosdis.nasa.gov/map/, or the US/Canada map) at a given area, dates, satellites, and basemap, so the user can see and explore the data themselves. The link is built from the map's own URL grammar and checked against its layer catalog; the result includes a plain-language `description` of what the link shows — tell the user what to expect.

Give either an `area` box (the map fits it and draws its outline) or a `center` with `zoom`; either a `period` (today, 24hrs, 48hrs, 72hrs, 7days) or `start_date`/`end_date` in UTC; and optionally FIRMS source IDs in `sources` to show individual satellites (Advanced mode). get_fire_detections already returns a link for its own query; use this tool for other views. Offer links as links; do not claim to have seen the map.

This tool does not need a FIRMS MAP_KEY.

area_week.description: Southern California, last 7 days, all detections
